scope: Native costs and payout model for the three weekly 20-win domain subgoals. No actual 60-fight combat/timing simulation, no real account or server was changed. These 60 payouts are a subset of all weekly branches, whose minimum workload is 140 victories.
assumptions: Daily 3 wins rotate TALENT -> ASCENSION -> EXP over seven Korean days.
The TALENT/ASCENSION/EXP 20-win subgoals include daily wins; this subset totals 60 payouts, not 81. It is not the entire weekly board: all weekly branches require at least 140 victories.
The first three material wins are shared per day. EXP does not consume them.
Leftover weekly wins settle on day seven. An alternate model adds three material wins on each EXP day.
MOND books and LIYUE books are separate. Current marker-one highest talent payouts are MOND level25 (32 base books) and LIYUE level60 (64).
Current own-element ASCENSION subset uses PYRO; quantities and phase costs are fixed independently by element. This is not a universal gem-rate or full-week forecast.
Books/gems are inventory supplies, not cloned separately for four participants.
